summary: Justin Favela announced a solo exhibition at the Berman Museum in Collegeville, Pennsylvania, running through December 17th, and an installation in the same museum through July of the following year. He also shared upcoming work at the Bury Art Museum in the UK and the Sugar Hill Children's Museum of Art and Storytelling in Harlem, opening mid-October. Alex, Kefir's manager, is cited as an example of successful management expansion that enabled growth in artistic visibility.
